description: This file contains power management functions and low power mode configurations for the NXP RT10XX SoC, including callbacks registration, sleep mode setup, voltage regulation, and initialization routines.

methods.name: imxrt_clock_pm_callbacks_register
methods.description: Registers clock callbacks for power management, ensuring low power and run modes are properly configured.

methods.name: lpm_set_sleep_mode_config
methods.description: Configures the system sleep mode, setting wakeup sources and low power mode parameters.

methods.name: lpm_enter_soft_off_mode
methods.description: Enters the soft-off power state, enabling RTC as a wakeup source.

methods.name: lpm_enter_sleep_mode
methods.description: Enters sleep or deep sleep mode based on the specified clock mode.

methods.name: lpm_set_run_mode_config
methods.description: Restores system configuration after waking from low power mode.

methods.name: bandgap_set
methods.description: Enables or disables the analog bandgap circuitry to save power.

methods.name: lpm_drop_voltage
methods.description: Reduces SOC voltage and switches to low power clocks for low power mode.

methods.name: lpm_raise_voltage
methods.description: Restores SOC voltage and clocks after exiting low power mode.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state, handling transitions into runtime idle, suspend, or soft off.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs post-wakeup activities, restoring system configuration based on the previous power state.

methods.name: rt10xx_power_init
methods.description: Initializes the power management system, configuring regulators and clocks.
